name: flash-games
description: Static browser player for .swf games powered by self-hosted Ruffle.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build scripts/app.ts sw.ts --root . --outdir dist --target browser && cp -R assets icons styles vendor index.html offline.html manifest.webmanifest dist/
scripts.dev: bun run build && python3 -m http.server 5173 --directory dist
scripts.check: bun lint && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check:renovate && bun check:types && bun check:unused && bun check:vulns && bun check:offline
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
